description: One call that answers 'where is my money': every wallet, venue, and open-position balance as one flat list, each entry saying what it is for and which call moves it. Defaults to a fast snapshot with explicit freshness; set wait_for_complete:true to wait through bounded venue refreshes. Sources that cannot be verified are listed as unavailable, never assumed zero. Prefer this over get_balances for money-tracking decisions. Allocated Hyperliquid, Lighter and Polymarket capital can return to Arc Home through preview_capital_move and start_capital_move; poll get_capital_move for reconciliation.

wait_for_complete.description: Wait through bounded venue refreshes. Defaults to false; fast snapshots still expose complete, total_complete, spendable_complete, stale_sources, and unavailable.

name: get_money_map
